name: Sidebar navigates to the Onboarding Tour; the seeded repo (clone, no index) renders the skeleton empty state
description: From the PR list, follows the sidebar's 'Onboarding Tour' entry (nav.ts row, AC-1) to /repos/:repoId/onboarding. The seeded demo repo has a clonePath (the L05 Project Context fixture) but no repo-intel index rows, so getIndexState reports degradedReason 'no_data' and the service's skeleton-reason ladder (server/src/modules/onboarding/service.ts) returns 'not_indexed' before ever calling a model (AC-24). Confirms the skeleton empty state's own copy — title and 'Try again' CTA (client/messages/en/onboarding.json skeleton.*) — rather than the page title, which also appears as the sidebar's own link text. Deterministic locators only, no chat, no model call — read-only seeded data throughout.
